entries.en: My name is [clr 1][var 2][clr 27]...[n]My existence shall become a new[n]part of you.
I already exist within your heart. There[n]cannot be two of the same being in[n]one soul.
To think you would coerce me into[n]giving in... How brilliant.
To think you would coerce me into[n]giving in... but I am already within you.[n]Any further exchange is meaningless.
